decision_scope: Static review of the one fixed six-file candidate only; coordinator launch decision and later frozen archive review remain separate.

facts: Exactly six frozen candidate files; manifest binds exactly the other five files.
All raw Git byte sizes and SHA256 values match.
Three diff hunks relative to the frozen original: module description, workflow identity, and system-proxy precondition plus explicit proxy context argument.
All six other function ASTs are unchanged; no execution or import of probe occurred.
Byte-for-byte equality confirmed.
Only ProxyEnable, AutoConfigURL and ProxyServer are queried inside the worker before GET.
ProxyEnable must equal 1, AutoConfigURL must be absent or empty, and ProxyServer must match one of four fixed no-userinfo loopback forms for port 7897.
Missing or changed enabled/server values, nonempty PAC, and registry errors stop before GET; values are never persisted or printed.
Explicit context proxy server is http://127.0.0.1:7897; no username or password supplied.
One context.get call site, fixed original public HTTPS target with no query or fragment.
timeout=30000, max_redirects=0, max_retries=0 and fail_on_status_code=False; no retry loop or fallback in worker.
Bound dependency supports and forwards these parameters; retry implementation immediately throws at maxRetries===0.
No HTTP credentials are supplied, so dependency Basic-auth retry condition cannot be satisfied.
GET reservation is durably written once before invocation; it is an intent count, not a packet count.
ignore_https_errors=False on context and GET; worker NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED is fixed to 1.
No storage_state, http_credentials, proxy credentials or client certificates are supplied.
Fresh standalone API context has a new cookie store; no browser or user profile is loaded.
The probe reads only response.status, validates integer 100..599, and has no body/text/json/headers/Location access or hash call.
No browser launch, persistent context, page navigation, login, book selection or business operation exists.
Per the inherited diagnostic boundary, dependency-internal response receipt/buffering is permitted; this check does not claim zero response bytes are received internally.
Original TYPES, CODES, PHRASES and safe_error implementation are unchanged.
Only allowlisted exception types/codes or UNKNOWN are retained; raw exception strings remain in-memory for matching only.
Child stdout/stderr go to DEVNULL; top-level exceptions produce only an exit code, no traceback.
Source/dependency checks and exclusive run-once marker precede Job and Popen setup.
Worker blocks for GO before Playwright starts; original child handle identity is checked and assigned to the new kill-on-close Job before GO.
No PID reopen, global process scan, taskkill or unrelated-process operation exists.
Supervisor uses setup gate deadline 10s, worker wait deadline 50s, release observation deadline 57s and reports <=60s.
Termination uses only the original child handle or owned Job; independent closes preserve unknown exit/active-count states.
cleanup_proven requires worker exit, zero owned Job processes, all handles closed and within_60_seconds. This is static logic, not a witnessed run.
All runtime artifacts use exclusive xb creation, flush and fsync, including run-once marker and first outcome.
First outcome is sealed before cleanup and cannot be overwritten; old evidence paths are not targeted.
Coordinator must supply the fixed candidate and manifest arguments and record the unique launch separately; this review creates no launch authority or marker.
All five declared immutable Git inputs were read with GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 and core.longpaths=true; their sizes and hashes matched.
The bound workflow input is the initial diagnosis at 9ff37e3f; the concrete observation addendum was also read from fixed candidate 6966509b, lines 14-26.
All six installed dependency files match declared raw-byte sizes and SHA256 values.
Installed METADATA Name/Version confirms playwright 1.58.0 without importing it.
Bound API accepts explicit proxy and all GET arguments; GlobalAPIRequestContext takes proxy from explicit options.
Runtime verify_inputs rechecks executable identity, version and six dependency pins before creating owned resources.

limits: No probe, Playwright runtime, browser, network request, login, registry query, credential read, ambient environment-value read or old business/test execution occurred in this review.
Proxy metadata and ordinary-browser availability are supplied context; this reviewer did not independently read registry or test the network.
Sixty-second closure and cleanup remain UNVERIFIED until the one authorized run produces frozen original-handle and Job evidence.

HTTP status, if later obtained, establishes only a response through this selected API proxy path; it cannot prove the historical cause, original browser recovery, authentication, book state or business qualification.
Dependency internals can receive/buffer response body and headers, as expressly permitted by inherited A10-public-transport-diagnostic.md line 10; the probe does not inspect, save or hash them.
static-check.json candidate_frozen=false is a preserved preparation-stage claim, not runtime evidence; this review is bound to immutable commit 6966509b and its independently verified manifest.
The commit also changes coordination-state.json and the diagnosis task addendum; only the addendum was used as authority context. This is not acceptance of broader scheduler metadata.
Old failures, exhausted budgets, other three HOLD cases and Q22 boundaries remain intact; no retry, second candidate, fallback, push or message is authorized by this report.

review_execution.git_read_mode: raw subprocess bytes; GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1; git -c core.longpaths=true
